text:
devin: proposal: add a "grace period" slider (0-30s) in rollout UI to delay fallback.

maria: yes. make it clear it's latency-only by default and separate for error triggers.

sam: default 5s, please add a small 'simulate spike' preview in console.

olivia: oncall-friendly labels: keep_trying / short_return / failfast. easier for runbooks.

ops-bot: feature-flag: fallback_grace_rollout=15%

maria: telemetry schema: record trigger_type, chosen_mode, ms_at_trigger, tokens_primary, tokens_fallback, sampled_trace_id. sampling per-org.

sam: audit policy: sampled raw outputs retained 90d; UI replay + side-by-side diff; RBAC restricts raw output view.

devin: console UX: inline pill "fell back: latency 5.2s • why" linking to trace and CTA "compare with primary".

maria: API: emit header X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=keep_trying;trigger=latency;trace=abc123 when fallback happens; optional fallback_meta in body if debug=true.

ops-bot: sampling defaults set to 0.1% org-wide; 5% for experiment cohorts.

devin: action items: telemetry PR, API header + body spec, console pill + compare flow, RBAC matrix, rollout plan. I'll drop a UI mock later.
